purpose: Pipeline B: before/after Sentinel-2 change signature of documented events, event discovery and label QA. Strictly separate from the precursor model (Pipeline A); post-event imagery never enters Pipeline A features.

source.events: data/v04/run_c6d67a854ba7/dataset.parquet (V0.4 positives and their 5 matched controls; read only)
source.partition: data/v04/partition/partition.json (independence units for event-level holdout; read only)

stac.collection_preference: sentinel-2-c1-l2a first (Collection-1 reprocessing, uniform processing baseline 05.xx); sentinel-2-l2a only where c1 has no item for that acquisition
stac.reflectance: reflectance = DN * 1e-4 + offset, DN 0 = nodata. offset = -0.1 for sentinel-2-c1-l2a (COGs store the BOA_ADD_OFFSET, vegetation green DN ~1400) and 0.0 for sentinel-2-l2a (Earth Search COGs are stored WITHOUT the offset for every processing baseline, vegetation green DN ~250-750, although raster:bands advertises -0.1). Verified empirically on 2026-10-14 (SCL-vegetation green medians of 15 pilot acquisitions); a runtime check refuses an acquisition whose vegetation green reflectance median falls outside [0.01, 0.2].
stac.page_note: limit 500 returned HTTP 502 for 300-day ranges on 2026-10-14; ranges with more matches than one page are split by date

eligibility.min_event_year_reason: Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A over Austria starts 2017-10; 2016/2017 events have no L2A pre-event imagery
eligibility.position_reason: the 320 m core window must contain the source area; 100 m upper bounds are marked position_coarse and excluded from training
eligibility.same_day_rule: an acquisition on the event day is never used (order relative to the event is ambiguous)
eligibility.scl_note: Sen2Cor scene classification: 3 cloud shadow, 8 medium-probability cloud, 9 high-probability cloud, 10 thin cirrus, 11 snow/ice, 0 nodata, 1 saturated/defective
eligibility.window_note: thresholds apply to the 320 m core and to the 960 m analysis window (core + ring); the outer 2.56 km patch is only used by discovery mode and is recorded, not required
eligibility.group_rule: before_primary/after_primary must be locally usable at the positive and at >= min_controls_usable of its 5 matched controls on the same acquisition (sibling tile of the same overpass allowed); controls usable on both acquisitions form the group

ndsi_snow.note: pixel is snow if (green - swir16)/(green + swir16) > ndsi_min and NIR > nir_min; checked in addition to SCL because the pilot showed a fully snow-covered scene with SCL snow 2 %

eligibility.max_doy_gap_note: before/after pair spanning more than this many days of the seasonal cycle (circular day-of-year distance) is excluded from training: phenology dominates the difference (pilot: November vs March)

patch.grid: UTM zone of the event (EPSG:32632 west of 12 E, else 32633), origin snapped to 10 m so that same-zone Sentinel-2 pixels map 1:1; other-zone items are warped onto the grid (bilinear reflectance, nearest SCL)

features.windows: small = 120 m box, core = 320 m box, ring = 960 m box minus core; contrast = window - ring controls for scene-wide seasonal, illumination and atmospheric differences

dataset.negatives: the 5 V0.4 matched controls of each eligible event, evaluated on the same before/after acquisitions (same date, same season, same snow and illumination state); label CONTROL_PSEUDO_NEGATIVE
dataset.holdout: V0.4 independence unit; no unit appears in both training and test folds
